primary_question: Does a response-blind EOG reachability relation among sampled island populations explain neutral genetic differentiation beyond geographic isolation and environmental difference?
pre_genetic_gates: Gate0 freeze exact 125-sample registry, island labels and response-free coordinates
Gate1 freeze geographic and environmental distance matrices
Gate2 freeze declared EOG transition-world family and occurrence relation graph
Gate3 freeze genetic predictor artifact, pair ordering, model ladder and fingerprints
Gate4 only after Gates0-3 are immutable, begin MIG-seq2 / SNP response generation

predictor_requirements.IBD: pairwise geographic distance among frozen population units
predictor_requirements.IBE: pairwise environmental distance from a response-free frozen environmental representation
predictor_requirements.EOG_relation: reachability distance or relation summary derived only from frozen occurrence anchors and transition worlds
predictor_requirements.strong_reference: a response-free graph/connectivity reference fixed before genetic response; if its own structural adequacy gate fails before response, the dataset stops rather than substituting a post-response reference

population_unit_rule.primary_unit: must be frozen from sample metadata before any genotype access
allowed_choices: predeclared field-site population when response-free sample counts support it
population_unit_rule.minimum_sample_size_rule: must be declared from sample metadata before genotype access

genetic_response.primary: neutral pairwise FST from quality-filtered genome-wide SNPs
genetic_response.locus_filtering: must be frozen before pairwise FST values are inspected
genetic_response.response_transform: must be frozen before pairwise FST values are inspected

validation_design.pairwise_nonindependence: hold out all pairs involving one population unit together
validation_design.reference_failure_rule: if the predeclared strong reference is structurally or operationally invalid, retain an indeterminate reference-failure status and do not rescue using a post-response comparator

claim_boundary: This test evaluates relation-level information, not historical-route truth.
A favorable result does not identify migration direction or ancestry.
A null/adverse result does not invalidate all EOG transition worlds.
Morphological PST and pollination results are outside the primary genetic-response endpoint.
next_authorized_action: freeze response-free sample/population registry and EOG predictor construction before any MIG-seq2 genotype processing
